a: Collect less, protect always, delete when done.
Do not trick users into consent or purchases.
Excluding users with disabilities is a product failure.
Do not hide outages from paying customers.
Be clear when outputs are machine-generated if it matters.
Models and data can encode bias; test and mitigate.
Know escalation paths for serious ethical concerns.
Consider how tools could be misused and add safeguards.
Ship work you would trust for your own family.
